name: hotspots
title: Hotspots
description: Named buttons placed over a picture or a video at a point, each present only between two moments of the clip, with the same choices as a plain list for people who cannot point at the picture.

meta.when: Something in the frame can be asked about or chosen while it is on screen: an object in a scene, a place on a still, a choice in a story. Put Hotspots inside the frame (VideoPlayer, or any `relative` box over a picture) and HotspotList after it; both take the same `hotspots`. A hotspot that appears is announced, because nothing else would tell a screen-reader user it is there. For a point on a map use the map's own markers; for marks on the time bar use the scrubber's `marks`.
meta.example:
const spots = [
  { id: "kiln", x: 32, y: 55, start: 4, end: 12, label: "The kiln door" },
  { id: "shelf", x: 70, y: 30, start: 9, end: 20, label: "Drying shelf" },
];
<VideoPlayerProvider>
  <VideoPlayer aria-label="Inside the workshop">
    <VideoPlayerVideo src="/workshop.mp4" />
    <Hotspots hotspots={spots} onSelect={(spot) => openCard(spot.id)} />
    <VideoPlayerControls>…</VideoPlayerControls>
  </VideoPlayer>
  <HotspotList hotspots={spots} onSelect={(spot) => openCard(spot.id)} aria-label="In this scene" />
</VideoPlayerProvider>
